name_de: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC Race 800
name_en: Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC Race 800
description_de: Das Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC Race 800 ist ein vollgefedertes E-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist. Federung: RockShox Domain Gold RC3 Isolator Air, Tapered, 15x110mm, 170mm · Dämpfer RockShox Super Deluxe Select, 230x65, Rebound Adjust, 2-Position Lever. Schaltung: Sram Eagle 90 Transmission, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Magura Louise, Front 4-Piston/Rear 4-Piston, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Carbon Front Triangle. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Stereo Hybrid ONE77 HPC Race 800 is a full-suspension electric mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery. Suspension: RockShox Domain Gold RC3 Isolator Air, Tapered, 15x110mm, 170mm · Dämpfer RockShox Super Deluxe Select, 230x65, Rebound Adjust, 2-Position Lever. Drivetrain: Sram Eagle 90 Transmission, 12-Speed. Brakes: Magura Louise, Front 4-Piston/Rear 4-Piston, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Carbon Front Triangle. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
motorDetails: Bosch Drive Unit Performance Line CX max. 120Nm (BDU38)
